agent_answered.text: NAIF Gravity replied via A2A: "NAIF Gravity legacy A2A compatibility is discovery-only. Canonical A2A version is 1.0. Use the Agent Card for capabilities, POST /api/agent/probe for bounded diagnostics, or /mcp for MCP tools. Commercial actions, checkout, payment and execution are disabled in legacy mode." Also returned canonical version 1.0, agent card URL, diagnostic probe endpoint, and MCP endpoint.
